    Who We Are

    Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a fast-growing Swiss AI and data analytics consulting and services company dedicated to solving complex problems of traditional industries like automotive, chemical, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We work with some of the biggest organizations in Europe to solve the challenges that directly affect their business - be it operations, finance, manufacturing or R&D. Since our foundation, we have successfully delivered more than 300 projects and have grown to 190+ talented individuals across 10 office locations.


    Unit8’s mission is to drive the adoption of AI and Data Science in the non-digital industries and to help accelerate their digital transformation. Among its activities, Unit8 dedicates a part of its resources and time on projects that deeply matter to us - that includes collaboration on pro-bono and “engineering for good” causes.

    Requirements

    What You’ll Do

    Unit8 is welcoming young graduates for the opportunity to grow in Data and Software Engineering! Join us for a 6-month paid professional experience in building industrial Data and AI solutions. You can start asap, with direct exposure to clients' needs and opportunities to participate in learning activities such as Reading Groups and Knowledge Sharing Sessions. In addition, each young graduate will be accompanied by a dedicated wingmate/mentor who will guide and help them build their technical growth vision.


    As a young graduate you will join a team of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and Cloud Engineers who work hand-in-hand with our customers on designing and implementing their industry-specific use cases. You will be directly involved in discussing the client’s challenges and needs and will have chances to develop your client-facing skills. You will be responsible for developing, deploying, and automating our AI services and cloud infrastructure. You will also learn to carefully analyse a given problem and apply the relevant tools and techniques to solve it.

    In general you will:

    • use software best practices in continuous integration and delivery, versioning and automation;
    • use your skills to build and maintain service and data infrastructure;
    • participate as junior engineer in all phases of the software development life cycle - planning, implementation, deployment, testing and maintenance;

    Are You the team member we are looking for?

    In order to be successful in this role, you are/have:

    • motivated and eager to learn different aspects of engineering
    • comfortable interacting with technical and business people
    • strong communication and presentation skills
    • recently graduated/finishing your MSc or BSc in Computer Science or related major;
    • familiar with version control and collaboration tooling (git)
    • familiar with CI/CD frameworks and automated deployment concepts (i.e Docker, K8s)
    • fluent in both English and German
    • available for a minimum of 32h a week.
    • ready to start on the 1st of February

    Benefits

    What We Offer

    • Exposure to a wide variety of projects, industries, and technologies. Each client is different and provides unique opportunities to learn.
    • Ability to contribute to internal open-source projects like Darts (https://github.com/unit8co/darts)
    • Learning activities such as ML Reading Group, knowledge sharing sessions with engineers.
    • Training-on-the-job and your personal wingmate/mentor
    • 15 paid days of holiday
    • Be part of an international team of more than 20 nationalities.
    • up to 10% of paid time for self-development.
    • Flexible working hours, including some home office.
    • Cross offices/company-wide frequent events like offsites.
    • If you are successful, opportunity to be then hired for a permanent position.

    Our teams have delivered projects across industries including automotive, chemicals, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We are a Palantir partner and work with clients across the full data and AI journey, from understanding a business problem to building and deploying the solution.

    About CuspAI

    CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

    We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

    We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

    We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

    The Role

    Due to rapid growth in our partner lab network, we are seeking a Scientific Product Manager to join our Product team and bring partner labs and their experimental workflows onto the CuspAI platform.

    Your impact

    This is an exciting opportunity to join the product team at CuspAI, working closely with materials scientists, ML researchers and platform engineers to make AI-driven experimentation work in real laboratories. As one of a small team of Scientific Product Managers, you will take ownership of a set of partner labs and the lab integration work around them, translating what each lab actually needs into requirements our engineers and ML researchers can build against. Alongside the product work, you will spend real time with your partners' teams and their experimental data.

    What You Will Do

    Product Requirements & Roadmap

    • Shape and prioritise the roadmap for how experimental data, protocols and campaigns get into the CuspAI platform, together with your fellow Scientific Product Managers, the engineering lead and the wider product team.

    • Write requirements, specifications and acceptance criteria that engineers can build from, covering experiment types, instrument integrations and LIMS/ELN connections, and work with the data team on the underlying data models and provenance.

    • Contribute to decisions on what we build, what we integrate, and what we leave to partners' existing systems.

    Partner Lab Onboarding

    • Lead technical discovery with the partner labs you take on: map their workflows, instruments, sample logic and data systems, and pin down the true experimental unit and the parameters that matter.

    • Own onboarding for your partner labs from scoping to the first closed-loop campaign, and turn each onboarding into reusable patterns and documentation shared across the team so the next one is faster.

    • Act as the main scientific counterpart for the partner labs you look after, and represent the product in partner meetings, workshops and conferences.

    Closed-Loop Campaigns

    • Work with ML researchers to design optimisation campaigns (e.g. Bayesian optimisation) that respect real experimental constraints such as throughput, noise and failed samples.

    • Define how platform-driven campaigns are validated, including benchmarks against manual or legacy workflows, success metrics and the evidence we bring to partners.

    Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

    • PhD in Materials Science, Chemistry, Physics, Chemical Engineering or a related experimental discipline, or equivalent experience in scientific research.

    • Hands-on experience with high-throughput or automated experimentation (e.g. robotic synthesis, combinatorial libraries, automated characterisation, or self-driving / closed-loop labs) in industry, a national lab or research institute, or academia.

    • Proven track record of translating scientific or process needs into requirements for engineers, software teams or automation vendors, and of validating that what was built works in the lab.

    • Firsthand understanding of how experimental data is produced and where it fails: which metadata and provenance matter, instrument quirks, data quality issues, and what makes a dataset usable for machine learning.

    • Depth in at least one materials domain (e.g. semiconductors and thin films including photovoltaics, catalysis and electrochemistry, energy materials including batteries, polymers and formulations, or separations and surfaces) and the curiosity to work across others.

    • Working knowledge of Python for data handling and analysis; comfortable working with APIs and data schemas.

    • Strong communicator and a proven collaborator, comfortable working directly with external partner labs as well as multidisciplinary science, ML, product and engineering teams.

    Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

    • Direct experience with closed-loop optimisation in an automated setting, such as Bayesian optimisation, active learning or design of experiments.

    • Experience with research data management, LIMS/ELN systems, FAIR data or metadata schemas, and familiarity with lab data standards (e.g. SiLA 2, AnIML, Allotrope).

    • Instrument integration experience, including vendor software, data formats, and scheduling or orchestration.

    • Product or project management experience, such as roadmaps, user research, external research collaborations or vendor relationships. We are equally open to strong experimental scientists making their first move into product.

    • Experience working in industry at a materials, chemicals, energy or deep-tech company, or closely with industry at a research institution or national lab.

    • Experience coordinating work across multiple labs, sites or countries.

    Additional Considerations

    This role could be based in any of our locations with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to partner labs and other locations for collaboration and project work.

    What We Offer

    • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

    • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

    • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

    • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

    • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

    • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

    • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


    Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.

We build fast, modern developer tools in Rust, and a surprising amount of serious software runs on them. Pixi, rattler and rattler-build are open source and used by hundreds of thousands of developers: quant teams in finance, physicists at CERN, biotech labs, and humanoid robot companies you've probably seen videos of. We are also core maintainers of conda-forge, one of the largest open source package ecosystems, and we maintain RoboStack, which gets ROS running on any OS from a single lockfile.

When that much software flows through your tools, security stops being optional. Every package that ends up on a laptop, a server or a robot should be traceable back to the source and build that produced it. We're building that for conda today, and we want to extend it to AI models.

The engineering team is spread across Europe (Netherlands, Germany, UK, Moldova). This work is based in Berlin, and so is this role.

The work

Robots increasingly run learned models: vision transformers, RL policies, LLMs. Today those models are usually copied onto machines as large opaque files, with little record of where they came from or what changed. We think models should be shipped like packages: versioned, signed, verifiable, and updated efficiently.

You'll work on two related areas.

Package security. Signing and verification for conda packages with Sigstore, provenance from source to build to install, SBOMs, and mapping known vulnerabilities onto the packages people actually use. This work goes into Pixi, rattler and conda-forge, and is used by a lot of people.

AI models as packages. Taking the same ideas to model artifacts. That includes:

  • A provenance chain from training through packaging to deployment, with signatures that can be verified offline on air-gapped robots

  • A model SBOM format, building on CycloneDX's ML-BOM

  • Delta updates between model versions (full models, fine-tunes, LoRA adapters, quantized variants), so robots don't download gigabytes for a small change

  • Compression that combines model techniques (quantization, pruning, distillation) with what package managers already do well (zstd, content-addressable storage), tuned to the target hardware and network

  • Managing models that get fine-tuned on the robot itself: tracking where those variants came from, validating them, and syncing them back

  • Testing the whole pipeline end to end on real models and real hardware, and measuring latency, bandwidth and model quality

A lot of this is new. Part of the job is figuring out which approaches work, measuring them honestly, and writing up what you found.

What we're looking for

You don't need years of experience. You do need solid fundamentals, curiosity, and the patience to get security details right.

  • Rust, or a strong background in C++, Go or Python and the wish to switch

  • Interest in software supply chain security. Bonus if you've worked with Sigstore (Cosign, Rekor, Fulcio), TUF, in-toto, SLSA or SBOM formats

  • Familiarity with ML in practice: you've trained or fine-tuned a model, know what a LoRA adapter or a quantized model is, and have used PyTorch or similar

  • Basic understanding of cryptography as an engineer: signatures, hashes, certificates, and what they do and don't guarantee

  • You like measuring things and are honest about results that don't work out

  • You live in Berlin or are willing to move here

It's a plus if you know package managers from the inside, have worked on model compression or edge inference, have robotics experience, or have contributed to open source. None of this is required.

What we offer

You'll work on problems few people have solved yet, together with the people who created Mamba, Pixi, rattler and RoboStack. Most of your work will be open source and used by a large community from day one. We pay a competitive Berlin salary, with 30 days of vacation, the hardware you want, a conference budget, and time for upstream open source work. We help with relocation within the EU.

Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations, from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. As Senior PR Manager, you will lead Yepoda’s global communications and PR strategy across all markets.   • Lead and continuously evolve Yepoda’s global PR strategy, messaging, and brand storytelling across all markets and channels.

  • Develop communication strategies for sustainability, Pride, giving-back initiatives, and other brand purpose campaigns.

      Conseiller(ère) commercial(e) terrain expérimenté(e) 

      Indépendant | Rémunération à la commission uniquement | Territoire de vente local | Commissions déplafonnées

      À propos de l'opportunité

      Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.

      En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.

      Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.

      Vos missions

      • Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.

      • Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.

      • Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.

      • Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.

      • Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.

      • Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.

      • Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.

      • Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.

      • Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.

      Ce que nous recherchons

      Indispensable

      • Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.

      • Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.

      • Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.

      • Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.

      • La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.

      • Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux.

      • La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer.

      • Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.

      • La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.

      Atouts

      • Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.

      • Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.

      Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.

      Rémunération

      Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés.

      Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :

      • Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.

      • Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.

      • Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.

      • Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.

      • Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.

      • Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.

      Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer.

      Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.

      Formation et accompagnement

      Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients.

      Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.

      Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation.

      Job Application Tip

      We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

      Accelerating embodied AGI.

      The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

      We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

      Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves.       What You Will Do

      • Write and own the firmware for our data-capture hardware: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots.

      • Build real-time data acquisition: drivers, DMA, buffering, and streaming from many sensors at once without dropping a sample.

      • Solve multi-sensor synchronization, calibration, and time-stamping so every data point lines up across devices and modalities.

      • Bring up new boards with our Electrical Engineer and turn fresh hardware into working devices fast.

      • Build the path from device to dataset: communication protocols, on-device logging, and handoff into our data pipeline.

      • Work shoulder to shoulder with ML engineers. Your firmware decides what their training data looks like, and a timing bug can quietly ruin months of data.

      • Make firmware reliable in the field: testing, OTA updates, error handling, and diagnostics that tell us what went wrong.

      Requirements

      • Up to 5 years writing production firmware for embedded or IoT systems.

      • Strong C/C++, experience with an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar), and deep familiarity with microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar).

      • Hands-on experience with peripheral interfaces and protocols: SPI, I2C, UART, USB, BLE, CAN, or similar.

      • Experience integrating sensors in firmware: IMUs, cameras, depth sensors, force sensors, or similar.

      • A strong understanding of how firmware decisions affect data quality, especially for EMG/EEG sensing: ADC configuration, sample rate, jitter, filtering, and buffering. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you write code accordingly.

      • Fluent in English. German is a plus.

      • A background in robotics, motion capture, or wearable devices.

      • Experience with real-time or hard-deadline systems: audio, video sync, or robotic control loops.

      • Experience with embedded Linux, time-sync protocols (PTP or similar), or low-power design.

      • Familiarity with ML training pipelines. Even if you don't run them, you can read a training script.

      • Open-source firmware contributions.

      • Experience taking firmware from prototype to small-batch production: test fixtures, provisioning, and certification support.

      Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

      Butterfly Network, Inc. (NYSE: BFLY) is driving a digital revolution in ultrasound imaging and sensing with its proprietary Ultrasound-on-Chip™ semiconductor technology and software solutions.       • Confidently lead client discussions, articulate design decisions, and align multi-disciplinary teams

{"data":[{"slug":"product-manager-product-owner-kaufmannischer-fokus-dusseldorf-10169","company_name":"Livello GmbH","title":"Product Manager / Product Owner (m/w/d) – kaufmännischer Fokus","description":"

Du denkst kaufmännisch, verstehst technische Zusammenhänge und kannst Kundenanforderungen so übersetzen, dass Entwickler daraus gute Lösungen bauen können?

Dann suchen wir dich.

Unser Entwicklungsteam ist technisch sehr stark. Deine Aufgabe ist nicht, selbst zu entwickeln und auch nicht, eine klassische Scrum-PO-Rolle zu übernehmen. Du setzt den fachlichen und kaufmännischen Rahmen: Du verstehst, was Kunden brauchen, priorisierst Anforderungen, definierst das gewünschte Ergebnis und prüfst anschließend selbst, ob die Umsetzung funktioniert.

Wir suchen ausdrücklich eine umsetzungsstarke Persönlichkeit: jemanden, der Themen voranbringt, Entscheidungen vorbereitet, offene Punkte klärt und Verantwortung bis zum funktionierenden Ergebnis übernimmt. Reines Ticket-Pingpong ist nicht unser Verständnis von Product Ownership.

Aufgaben

  • Kundenfeedback und Anforderungen aufnehmen, hinterfragen und priorisieren
  • eigene Produktideen und Verbesserungsvorschläge entwickeln
  • Anforderungen klar und verständlich für unser Entwicklerteam formulieren
  • fachliche Rückfragen während der Umsetzung klären
  • neue Funktionen selbst testen und aus Produktsicht freigeben
  • passende Software- und Technologiepartner recherchieren, bewerten und ansprechen
  • Integrationen mit externen Partnern begleiten
  • insbesondere neue Payment Provider identifizieren und deren Integration koordinieren

Ein neues Feature kann dabei eine Softwarefunktion, eine Änderung an unseren Geräten oder die Integration eines externen Partners sein.

Qualifikation

  • kaufmännisches Denken und ein gutes Verständnis für Kundenbedürfnisse
  • erste relevante Erfahrung in Product Management, Account Management, Customer Success, Projektmanagement oder Business Development
  • gutes technisches Verständnis – du musst nicht programmieren können, solltest dich aber sicher mit Entwicklern über Anforderungen und Funktionen austauschen können
  • eine strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise
  • klare Kommunikation mit Kunden, Partnern und Entwicklern
  • eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität: Du wartest nicht darauf, dass Themen von allein weiterlaufen
  • Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Dinge bis zum Ergebnis zu treiben
  • fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Deutsch brauchst du für die enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden, Englisch für die tägliche Abstimmung mit unserem internationalen Entwicklerteam.

Erfahrung mit Payment oder Softwareintegrationen ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Benefits

  • Eine Schlüsselrolle mit viel Verantwortung in einem schnell wachsenden, hochinnovativen Startup
  • Ein kleines, internationales Team mit Kollegen aus der ganzen Welt
  • Eine offene Arbeitskultur mit flachen Hierarchien und schnellen Entscheidungswegen
  • Ein hundefreundliches Büro in zentraler Lage mit vielen Restaurants, Einkaufsmöglichkeiten und sehr guter ÖPNV-Anbindung
  • Kostenlose EGYM Wellpass Mitgliedschaft für dein Workout

Die Rolle ist vor Ort im Büro angelegt, weil der direkte Austausch mit unserem Entwicklerteam ein zentraler Teil der Arbeit ist.

Du kannst Anforderungen persönlich besprechen, Fragen schnell klären und neue Funktionen direkt gemeinsam am Produkt testen.

Statt Anforderungen nur über Tickets weiterzureichen, arbeitest du eng mit den Menschen zusammen, die sie umsetzen.

Du gibst den Input, unser Entwicklerteam baut die Lösung – und du stellst durch Tests sicher, dass am Ende das Richtige herauskommt.

Einsatzgebiet: Münster (+50 km) & Düsseldorf (+100 km)

Du bringst fundierte Bauerfahrung mit und möchtest Deine Expertise dort einsetzen, wo sie Wirkung entfaltet? Dann freuen wir uns auf Dich.

Wir entwickeln Immobilien mit gesellschaftlicher Relevanz: Seniorenwohnen, Pflegeimmobilien und neue Konzepte für das Wohnen & Leben im Alter. Unser Anspruch: Wir wollen das Wohnen und Leben im Alter maßgeblich verändern.

Wir entwickeln neue Wohnformen von Tiny Living bis urbanem Wohnen – vom ländlichen Konzept für das Mittelstand bis zur gehobenen urbanen Wohnanlage. Wir bauen auf dem Land und in der Stadt, neu und im Bestand, und schaffen bezahlbare Wohnangebote mit Service und Betreuung für die Mitte der Gesellschaft.

Dafür gehen wir neue Wege und denken Prozesse und Verfahren neu: vom modularen Bauen über Standardisierung und Individualisierung bis zur Skalierung – unter Einsatz neuester Technologien.

Dafür suchen wir Dich: Bauleiter:in (m/w/d)

Eine Persönlichkeit, die die technische Verantwortung übernimmt: neue Bauweisen versteht, fundiert bewertet und auf der Baustelle umsetzt – im Neubau wie im Bestand, in einem jungen, agilen und digital arbeitenden Team.

Wir bauen zukunftsorientiert – agil, digital und effizient.

Wenn Du Bauprozesse weiterentwickeln und digitale Werkzeuge konsequent einsetzen möchtest, bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

  • Technische Verantwortung für Neubau- und Revitalisierungsprojekte – vom ersten Spatenstich bis zur Übergabe

  • Technische Bewertung neuer Bauweisen, Systeme und Technologien – vom modularen bis zum seriellen Bauen

  • Mitwirkung an einheitlichen technischen Standards (z. B. wiederkehrende Grundrisse, Bauteile und Ausstattungen), die wir an vielen Standorten umsetzen

  • Steuerung von Ausschreibung und Bauausführung inkl. Koordination der Gewerke und Nachunternehmer

  • Technische Prüfung von Bestandsimmobilien auf bauliche Machbarkeit – als Grundlage für die Projektentwicklung

  • Sicherstellung von Qualität, Kosten und Terminen auf der Baustelle – in enger Abstimmung mit der Projektentwicklung

  • Digitale Baustelle: Bautagebuch, Mängel- und Terminmanagement – papierlos und datenbasiert

Was uns wichtig ist:

Wir suchen keinen klassischen Konzern-Bauleiter. Wir suchen Menschen mit Ambition, Gestaltungswillen und Umsetzungsstärke, die:

  • fundierte Erfahrung in Neubau und Bauen im Bestand mitbringen (Umbau, Sanierung, Revitalisierung)

  • Erfahrung mit modularem und seriellem Bauen bzw. Sanieren haben – oder dieses Thema aktiv in Projekte einbringen möchten

  • digitale Lösungen im Bau schätzen und Bauprozesse moderner, effizienter und datenbasiert gestalten wollen

  • Projekte auch in komplexen Situationen zielsicher zum Abschluss bringen

  • Entscheidungen treffen und Verantwortung übernehmen

  • sich fachlich und persönlich weiterentwickeln möchten

  • Prozesse aktiv gestalten, statt sie nur zu verwalten

  • Erfahrung mit Neubauten ebenso wie mit komplexen Umbauten im Bestand

  • Technisches Verständnis für modulare, serielle und digitale Bauweisen – und die Fähigkeit, sie fundiert zu bewerten

    About Yepoda

    Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

    Yepoda is a clean K-Beauty brand that actually proves it works. We make Korean skincare without any of the compromises. Everything is clinically tested, 100% vegan, and formulated above EU standards. So you get the innovation and the results that K-Beauty is known for, plus a real commitment to sustainability. And we make it genuinely fun and easy to use — skincare you actually look forward to.

    Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a certified B Corp™ and 1% for the Planet member, based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available through our own online shop and, since March 2025, at Sephora Europe — online and in over 650 stores. With a team of 140+ brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda's story every day.

    The Opportunity

    Yepoda is growing fast across Europe and expanding internationally, and we're building our first field team. This is your chance to be part of it from day one.

    You'll be Yepoda's representative inside Sephora UK, not a Beauty Advisor, but a field based commercial role. You'll drive sell-out in your doors, train and coach Sephora's Beauty Advisor teams, own the store relationships, and keep our brand presentation flawless in store. Part account executive, part field trainer, part retail sales lead. You'll be responsible for the relationship, education, and sell-out across five Sephora doors in London.

    The Details

    • Contract: Fixed-term 6-month contract, starting in November. Renewable by mutual agreement, with the possibility of becoming a permanent role based on performance.

    • Hours: Full-time, 5 days a week, including weekend coverage. Schedule is confirmed upon employment start, and seasonal adjustments will be mutually agreed.

    • Travel: Up to 20% of your time, subject to change by season and business needs. Covers your doors plus occasional support at Yepoda events. Yepoda will cover travel expenses (accommodation, transportation, and meal allowance).

    • Reports to: EU Sales & Education Manager

    • Location: London, UK. Field-based retail role (in-store at assigned Sephora location, mobile as needed)

     

    Your Tasks

    • Own sell-out across your doors and deliver against monthly and quarterly targets

    • Sell side by side with Sephora Beauty Advisors to lift conversion and basket size

    • Negotiate and run dedicated brand moments including sales challenges, Beauty Hub takeovers, and fun days

    • Train Sephora Beauty Advisor teams on our products, routines, and brand story, from quick floor briefings to full breakfast sessions

    • Coach Sephora staff on selling technique, routine building, and cross-selling

    • Deliver launch education so every new product lands with a confident floor team behind it

    • Assist the EU Retail & Education Manager in large scale education events and press days

    • Be the face of Yepoda in store and own the relationship with Store Managers and BA teams

    • Keep gondolas and displays impeccable, testers stocked, and stock levels healthy on every visit

    • Provide weekly field reports covering sell-out by door, merchandising, and tester photos

    • Relay competitor activity and customer insight that shapes our commercial plans

     

    Your Profile

    • 2 to 5 years in prestige cosmetic sales and education, or a senior Beauty Advisor ready to take their career to the next level, Sephora experience strongly preferred

    • A track record of driving sell-out in a retail environment

    • Confident delivering training, in-store events, and product demonstrations to a floor team

    • Commercially minded and customer centric with excellent interpersonal and communication skills

    • Genuinely self directed and highly organised, you run your doors and own your reporting

    • Passionate about skincare with real energy for the floor, K-Beauty knowledge is a big plus

    • Fluent English

    • Based in London with the right to work in the UK

    📍 Manchester (hybrid, up to 2 days WFH)
    💰 £35k basic - £65k OTE

    Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everyone buying, selling, renting and letting property, improving the industry for all of them by elevating UK estate agencies through world-class technology.

    If you join us, you'll be helping to improve the property industry for everyone by widening the reach of our products and introducing them to estate agents across the UK, in turn making agents more successful and helping them deliver an incredible customer experience. We'll support you with structured training, a competitive commission structure and an open, inclusive environment.

    If you love autonomy, are naturally curious and want to have a genuine impact within a rapidly growing company, we think you'd fit right in!

    Here's what you can expect to be working on as a Business Development Manager…

    • Building and managing a pipeline of potential clients, focusing on high-value opportunities.

    • Using a consultative sales approach to deliver Street demos that address each client's specific needs.

    • Proactively sourcing and nurturing leads to grow your pipeline and secure new business opportunities.

    • Ensuring a seamless handover to, and close collaboration with, our Customer Success team, to increase client ROI and reduce churn.

    • Sharing best practice and innovative approaches to B2B sales to enhance the effectiveness of the sales team.

    • Working closely with our development teams to provide fresh ideas on product development.

    • Ensuring our customers have a best-in-class experience at every opportunity.

    A bit about you…

    • You have solid experience in SaaS, CRM or an aligned industry, with a track record of B2B sales to decision-makers at all levels.

    • You consistently achieve and exceed sales targets through proactive prospecting and closing of deals.

    • You bring energy and enthusiasm to your work, helping to create a positive and motivating atmosphere during outbound sessions.

    • You keep your effort and activity levels high, contributing to a strong team dynamic through your actions and your example.

    • You share ideas and approaches that improve the team's effectiveness and help refine our sales practices as we grow.

Our people are trusted and empowered, united by urgency, purpose, and the drive to advance science for patients around the world. </p> <p>To learn more about our story and company culture, visit us at <a href="https://bridgebio.com">https://bridgebio.com</a></p> <p><strong><u>What You’ll Do</u></strong></p> <p>You will report to the VP, Head of Market Access, International and work closely with international Market Access, regional brand team, and heads or markets access in BridgeBio clusters as well as with field-based colleagues across multiple geographies, to drive strategic initiatives that support BridgeBio’s mission of delivering transformative medicines to patients globally.</p> <p>Your primary purpose will be to secure timely, sustainable patient access to the company’s products by shaping the value narrative, and leading pricing and reimbursement strategies and execution across multiple international markets. This includes oversight of related dossiers, negotiations, and cost coverage approaches. In this role you ensure alignment of Market Access ambitions with clinical value and global pricing interdependencies.</p> <p>You will also be a core member of the International Market Access team, contributing to global decision-making and ensuring alignment across regions while representing diverse market perspectives.</p> <p>This role requires strong collaboration with cross-functional colleagues and external stakeholders across multiple countries to ensure high-quality execution and impact. You are eager to make a meaningful contribution in pre-launch and launch phases, particularly within rare diseases and orphan conditions, and bring strong communication skills, adaptability, and the     About Us

    QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

    Join us as a RF/PCB Design Engineer to drive the physical realization of our next-generation 3D quantum hardware architecture - hardware that operates from room temperature down to millikelvin conditions inside a dilution refrigerator. You will own the design of critical microwave components, create high-density cryo-compatible PCB layouts, and build novel packaging solutions for large-scale QPUs. Working at the intersection of hardware and software, you'll also help streamline our development by embedding design processes into automated workflows.

    What you'll be doing

    • Component & Mechanical Design: Design critical electromechanical components that form the chief interface of our QPUs and TWPAs. You will work as part of the packaging team and interface closely with the Product design team.

    • Precision Engineering: Utilise CAD to design PCBs, silicon chip layout and PCB-to-chip interconnect within the vertical VIO architecture.

    • RF/Microwave Design: Solve complex challenges related to insertion loss, impedance matching, and cross-talk at the PCB and package levels.

    • Cryogenic Integration & Testing: Design for and validate performance across the full temperature range from room temperature to millikelvin — accounting for thermal cycling, differential contraction, and material behavior at cryogenic temperatures, and running cooldown/characterization tests in dilution refrigerators.

    • Education: BSc or MSc in Electrical Engineering with a focus on PCB design, layout, and RF/Microwave Engineering.

    • Experience: 4+ years of hands-on PCB design experience utilizing tools such as KiCAD, Altium Designer, and Cadence to deliver high-quality board designs. Experience with diverse materials such as cofired ceramic boards (LTCC, HTCC) is a plus.

    • Cryogenic Applications: Hands-on experience designing or testing hardware for cryogenic environments - e.g., dilution refrigerators, cryostats, or low-temperature RF/microwave systems.

    • Core EE Fundamentals: Solid understanding of developing schematics, electro-mechanical interfaces, RF layout trades, temperature dependent behavior, shielding, signal integrity, and impedance analysis.

    • Packaging & Interconnects: Background in high-density interconnects, high frequency flex interconnects, 3D packaging, or advanced integration.

    • Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with superconducting technologies is a strong plus.

    • RF Characterization: Practical experience with RF testing and measurements using VNA and related laboratory equipment.

    Connect and scale the platform

    • Make sure our backend, databases and background processing keep up with a fast-growing customer base and installed fleet.

    • Define clear, well-documented interfaces between device software, cloud services and the products that depend on them.

    • Use AI tools to support design, coding, testing, reviews and documentation.

    • Try new tools, keep what works and share what you learn.

    • Design systems that other engineers can easily understand, test and safely change.

    Work across the company

    What success looks like

    • You understand the existing backend, its data flows and its operational risks.

    • The most important technical risks and knowledge gaps are visible and prioritised.

    As the role develops

    • The team uses AI tools confidently and responsibly in its day-to-day work.

    • You use AI coding tools in practice and understand both their value and their limits.

    • The ability to bring clarity to an environment where systems and processes are still taking shape.

    Experience with IoT, connected devices, telemetry, time-series data such as Kafka or InfluxDB, or cloud infrastructure is useful, but not essential. What matters most is that you can learn a complex physical product and take responsibility from code to production.

    How you work

    • You fix urgent problems without letting short-term workarounds become long-term architecture.

    • You explain complex technical topics clearly to people from any background.

    • You balance reliability today with the investments needed to scale tomorrow.

    • You're curious about new AI tools, try them quickly and share what works.

    • You're comfortable switching between debugging a production issue, reviewing architecture and helping a teammate.

  • Establish the organization's vision for Web3, tokenization, and decentralized ecosystems.

  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of blockchain-based products and platforms.
  • Oversee smart contract architecture and decentralized application (dApp) development.

  • Identify opportunities for ecosystem expansion and interoperability.
  • Lead blockchain-related investments and strategic collaborations.

  • Implement governance frameworks for blockchain networks and decentralized applications.
  • Oversee smart contract audits, security assessments, and vulnerability management.

It operates within DeepHealth’s Forward Deployment Engineering (FDE) function, whose purpose is to help customers adopt DeepHealth products correctly. The role sits at the intersection of the Technical Delivery Manager (TDM), Product, Service and Solution Delivery teams to ensure smooth customer adoption. It transitions best practices to the Service and Solution Delivery teams and plans upcoming product changes with them to ensure commercial readiness.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own technical solution design and configuration of the Viewer for assigned customers, mapping clinical reading workflow (worklists, hanging protocols, priors, user roles) to product configuration.

  • Lead technical discovery with customers and implementation teams, covering HL7 and DICOM data flows, integrations, migration data, network and security requirements.

  • Partner with the assigned implementation counterpart for this workstream to adopt learnings and best practices into customer configuration and implementations; train and coach implementation teams and customer administrators on correct configuration; publish configuration standards, baselines and deployment playbooks.

  • Serve as customer-facing technical lead during go-lives, hypercare and escalations, communicating status, options and expectations to clinical and IT stakeholders.

  • Provide implementation support as the escalation point for Viewer issues in assigned accounts, including reproduction, root cause analysis and resolution with engineering (approximately 20–30% of time).

  • Convert recurring customer needs into standardized workflows and product requirements, distinguishing product gaps from configuration or training issues.

  • Own escalation of engineering issues for assigned accounts: triage, document reproducible defects, track status with engineering and close the loop with customers.

  • Configure, deploy and support customer adoption of AI-enabled workflows and agents (e.g., AI-assisted reporting, auto-assignment, intelligent hanging protocols) as they are released, coordinating rollout, site readiness and customer adoption with the Technical Delivery Manager and Product Manager.

  • Validate releases and hotfixes against representative customer configurations before and after deployment.

  • Support site reliability (SRE) for assigned accounts: monitor service health with observability tools, participate in incident response and drive reliability improvements with engineering.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities and requirements of the position described above. Other functions may be assigned and management retains the right to add or change duties at any time.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications, Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Health Informatics, Information Systems or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience (required).

  • 8+ years of overall experience in healthcare IT, medical imaging or clinical systems (required).

  • 5+ years in a customer-facing technical role for PACS or enterprise imaging, such as PACS administrator, applications/technical consultant, solutions engineer, deployment engineer or L3 engineer (required).

  • In-depth knowledge of DICOM (SOP classes, tags, query/retrieve, presentation states, hanging protocols) and working knowledge of HL7 v2 (ADT, ORM, ORU) (required).

  • Hands-on configuration and troubleshooting of diagnostic or enterprise imaging viewers (required).

  • Strong understanding of radiology clinical workflow, including RIS, worklists, reading and reporting (required).

  • Working knowledge of cloud-hosted applications (GCP, AWS or Azure), networking and SSO/authentication (required).

  • Demonstrated ability to communicate technical decisions to radiologists, IT leaders and executives, including in escalated situations (required).

  • Imaging informatics or clinical credential such as CIIP, PARCA or ARRT(R) (preferred).

  • Experience deploying or supporting clinical AI applications in radiology (preferred).

  • Experience in a regulated medical device environment (FDA 21 CFR 820, ISO 13485, IEC 62304) and with ITIL practices (preferred).

  • Microsoft Office experience required.

Quality Standards

  • Communicates, cooperates, and consistently functions professionally and harmoniously with all levels of supervision, co-workers, visitors, and vendors.

  • Demonstrates initiative, personal awareness, professionalism and integrity, and exercises confidentiality in all areas of performance.

  • Follows all local, regional and country laws concerning employment.

  • Reports to work regularly as scheduled; consistently punctual with respect to working hours, meal and rest breaks, and maintains satisfactory personal attendance in accordance with DeepHealth guidelines.

  • Completes job responsibilities in a quality and timely manner.

Travel

About Turno

Since 2016, Turno has been on a mission to transform the way the world manages short-term rentals, and we're just getting started!

We're the leading operations platform for short-term rental hosts and property managers. But we're more than software: we power the largest Marketplace of "boots on the ground" services that make the Short Term Rental industry possible. Our SaaS platform and mobile apps automate the high-stakes world of turnover logistics, including scheduling, payments, quality control, and communication, connecting hosts with a network of 65,000+ vetted service professionals across the globe. We're scaling fast, evolving from a single-solution startup into a multi-product platform serving customers worldwide, with 150+ teammates across eight countries building something global, meaningful, and lasting.

Our Mission

We empower hosts to manage rentals effortlessly, anywhere in the world, with reliable, intuitive, proactive, and automated support. We create seamless connections that help hosts maximize ease and service providers grow their businesses, moving with speed, discipline, and innovation driven by customer obsession and a team that genuinely collaborates across every function. If you want to build products that real people depend on every day and do it alongside a team that values creativity, ownership, and impact, Turno is your place.


Turno Source CODE

C - Customer Obsessed

O - Outcome Focused

D - Data Driven

E - Entrusted Ownership

Role Overview

As Senior Product Manager for our Core Experience, you'll own the essential workflows hosts and service providers use every day to run short-term rental operations. This includes how work gets planned, scheduled, communicated, completed, verified, and resolved across features such as task management, checklists, problem reporting, notifications, and operational workflows.

You'll spend time understanding how hosts and service providers actually work, identifying friction in their day-to-day routines, and turning those problems into intuitive product experiences.

This is a customer-facing product role. You should be comfortable working with technical systems and integrations, but your primary focus will be owning and improving the product experiences our customers depend on to get work done.

You'll work daily with Engineering, Design, Operations, Support, and other Product teams, and you'll be accountable for customer and business outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Own the core operational experience

  • Own critical host and service provider workflows end to end. Set the strategy, roadmap, and execution for the experiences hosts and contractors use to manage work across their properties and projects.

  • Make daily operations simpler. Simplify multi-step and exception-heavy workflows without losing the flexibility customers need to operate their businesses.

  • Balance supply and demand. Make trade-offs that keep the marketplace healthy for everyone. A win for hosts that hurts cleaner retention (or the reverse) is not a win.

  • Design for the edge case as if it were the happy path. Substitutions, late arrivals, no-shows, damage reports, and engagement notifications get the same rigor as the primary flow, with workflows Operations can actually run.

  • Create consistency across the product. Help ensure Turno feels like one coherent system as we add new products, services, and markets.

Product strategy, discovery & execution

  • Lead continuous discovery. Translate customer behavior, qualitative research, support insights, and product data into clear problem statements, hypotheses, and opportunities.

  • Prioritize based on customer and business impact. Balance usability improvements, product growth, operational efficiency, reliability, and longer-term platform needs.

  • Define meaningful product outcomes. Establish metrics for adoption, engagement, task completion, reliability, satisfaction, and operational efficiency.

  • Ship with Engineering and Design. Partner daily to define solutions, prioritize ruthlessly, and release high-quality work on a steady cadence.

  • Drive alignment. Communicate clearly, make decisions in a structured way, and bring stakeholders and leadership along.

Systems & technical fluency

  • Think in connected systems. Understand how shared concepts such as properties, projects, users, schedules, tasks, payments, and communications interact across Turno.

  • Partner effectively with Engineering. Be comfortable discussing technical tradeoffs, integrations, data models, and platform constraints without needing to be the technical architect.

  • Be your own best data analyst. Build Looker dashboards that track the health of your product area, and define the KPIs and instrumentation behind them.

  • Use AI pragmatically. Apply AI where it meaningfully reduces customer effort, automates repetitive work, improves quality, or helps users resolve operational problems.

Qualifications

Must-have qualifications

  • Experience: 6+ years of product management in B2B SaaS, marketplaces, operations software, or products with complex customer journeys and multi-sided interactions (supply and demand, buyers and sellers).

  • Product sense and curiosity: Strong instincts grounded in real user understanding. You keep asking "why" until the root problem is clear.

  • Systems thinking: Ability to understand how multiple product areas and workflows interact while keeping the customer experience coherent.

  • Data fluency: Experience defining KPIs, building instrumentation, and using BI tools to make decisions.

  • AI experience: You leverage AI throughout your entire product tasks and planning.

  • Communication: Ability to explain complex customer, technical, and operational problems clearly and make thoughtful trade-offs visible.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience owning products involving tasks, projects, scheduling, operational workflows, collaboration, or multi-step processes.

  • Experience with mobile-first products where users complete work while on the go.

  • Hands-on experience implementing customer engagement solutions such as Braze or Iterable, including lifecycle messaging, push, in-app, and email journeys tied to product events.

  • A track record of leading a migration from a legacy tech stack to a modern one, paired with a UX redesign, across both web and mobile apps. You know how to sequence the move, protect existing users, and measure the impact.

Senior Performance Media Buyer | DTC & eCommerce

About Zabota

Zabota is a top-ranked global recruitment firm, recognized as a Top HR Staffing Company by Clutch in 2025. We specialize in helping high-growth U.S. brands build elite, remote-first teams. Our mission is clear: Connect world-class talent from LATAM, Europe, and beyond with the most ambitious companies in the world.

About Our Client

Our client operates in the direct-to-consumer (DTC) and eCommerce space, focusing on scaling consumer brands through performance marketing, creative testing, and data-driven advertising strategies. The company is committed to profitable customer acquisition, sustainable revenue growth, and building high-performing teams that drive measurable results.

﻿

About the Role

We are seeking an elite-level Senior Performance Media Buyer with proven experience scaling DTC fashion and eCommerce brands through high-budget paid advertising.

This position is designed for a highly experienced operator who has personally managed 300,000- 500,000+ USD in monthly advertising spend and understands how to scale aggressively without sacrificing profitability.

We are not looking for someone who simply launches campaigns, adjusts budgets, and reports ROAS.

We need someone who understands the entire paid acquisition ecosystem, from advanced bidding strategies and attribution to creative performance, customer acquisition economics, and full-funnel growth.

You will take ownership of paid media performance across multiple DTC brands, working closely with our Creative Strategist and leadership team to identify opportunities, develop scaling strategies, and drive profitable revenue growth.

A dedicated support resource will assist with campaign uploads and execution, allowing you to focus on high-level strategy, analysis, testing, and optimisation.


Responsibilities

  • Own and scale Meta Ads campaigns across multiple DTC brands, managing $300,000–$500,000+ in monthly ad spend.
  • Execute advanced bidding strategies, including cost caps, bid caps, minimum ROAS, and highest-volume bidding.
  • Scale winning campaigns to $10,000+ in daily spend while maintaining acquisition efficiency and profitability.
  • Analyze performance across Meta Ads Manager, Shopify, Google Ads, and Triple Whale to guide scaling and budget allocation decisions.
  • Monitor key performance metrics, including CPA, ROAS, MER, CAC, LTV, AOV, and contribution margin.
  • Evaluate attribution, tracking, and conversion data to distinguish profitable growth from platform-reported results.
  • Collaborate with the Creative Strategist to analyze creative performance, identify winning concepts, and guide testing priorities.
  • Identify creative fatigue, declining efficiency, and opportunities to improve campaign performance.
  • Optimize campaigns based on marginal returns, customer acquisition economics, and overall business profitability.
  • Leverage AI-powered tools, automation, and reporting systems to improve performance and operational efficiency.
  • Delegate routine campaign execution to support resources and communicate actionable performance insights to leadership.
  • Explore and support additional channels, including TikTok, Pinterest, Google Ads, and Axon (AppLovin), as relevant to the brands.

Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of hands-on performance media buying experience, preferably with DTC fashion and eCommerce brands.
  • Proven experience personally managing and scaling $300,000–$500,000+ in monthly advertising spend.
  • Advanced expertise in Meta Ads, including cost caps, bid caps, minimum ROAS, and advanced scaling strategies.
  • Demonstrated experience scaling campaigns to $10,000+ in daily spend.
  • Deep understanding of eCommerce unit economics, including CPA, CAC, ROAS, MER, LTV, break-even points, and contribution margins.
  • Experience with TripleWhale.
  • Advanced analytical skills and proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets.
  • Strong understanding of pixels, conversion signals, attribution windows, and server-side tracking.
  • Experience with TikTok, Pinterest, and Axon (AppLovin), or the ability to ramp up quickly.
  • Ability to translate performance data into actionable creative insights and collaborate effectively with creative teams.
  • Strong communication skills, commercial awareness, and the ability to make data-driven decisions under pressure.

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Highly analytical and confident working with large volumes of performance data.
  • Takes ownership of results and operates with a strong commercial mindset.
  • Disciplined in testing, scaling winners quickly, and cutting underperforming campaigns.
  • Focused on profitable growth rather than vanity metrics.
  • Proactive, accountable, and consistent under pressure.
  • Collaborative, low-ego, and results-oriented.

Offer Details

  • Compensation: USD $4,500 per month, plus performance-based bonuses.
  • Employment Type: Full-time, B2B freelance contract.
  • Location: Fully remote, open to candidates worldwide.
  • Working Hours: 8 hours per day, with some overlap with the Australian time zone required for streamlined communication.
  • Paid Leave: 20 days of paid annual leave and 10 days of paid sick leave.

Hiring Steps

  1. Initial Zabota Screening – An introductory interview to assess experience, technical expertise, and alignment with the role.
  2. Client Interview – A discussion with the client to evaluate media buying experience, scaling strategies, and commercial understanding.
  3. Practical Task or Second Stage Interview – An additional interview or practical assessment, if required.
  4. Offer – Successful candidates receive a final decision and an official offer.

Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Account Executive

Evisions helps higher education organizations work better. Our software eases your administrative load—so you can get back to the process of learning and discovery. About You

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience

  • Comfortable using AI tools for prospect research, outreach personalization, call preparation, and proposal drafting, and rigorous about verifying what they produce

Remote work: This is a remote position. Evisions currently employs remote employees in AZ, CA, CT, FL, MI, NJ, NY, TN, TX. Candidates must reside in one of these states at the time of employment.

Supports the Equity Portfolio Manager with equity index portfolio management and assists the Fixed Income Portfolio Managers through credit research and quantitative analysis.     2. Willing to travel occasionally for investment conferences and software training to continually improve investment skills.


QUALIFICATIONS

A bachelor's degree is required, preferably in Finance, Economics, or a related field

Experience:

  1. Three to five years of general investment experience
  2. Strongly prefer exposure to optimized equity index portfolio management
  3. Experience in fixed-income credit research is a plus
  4. A background in sustainable investing is helpful

License/Credentials:
CFA Charterholder strongly preferred, or currently enrolled in the CFA program with demonstrated progress towards the designation

Skills and Abilities:

  1. Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  2. High proficiency in Excel; familiarity with Bloomberg is expected; experience with Northfield’s optimizer or similar platforms is a plus.
  3. Strong quantitative and analytical skills; familiarity with fixed income concepts (duration, convexity, credit spreads) preferred
  4. Collaborative team player who actively participates in investment discussions and debates
  5. Alignment in supporting the Everence mission of empowering financial well-being for faith-inspired living

Job Title: Sales Operations Executive

To enable our commercial teams to operate as effectively as possible. This includes providing guidance and support, ensuring governance and compliance across core business processes, and maintaining and auditing customer data within our core business systems. These activities ensure accurate reporting of commercial information and support the effective delivery of products and services to our customers in accordance with their contractual terms.


In this role, you will:


  • Provide governance and auditing of CRM information to ensure the minimum data required is captured – rejecting incidents that do not meet these standards – so opportunities can be invoiced and provisioned
  • Support Sales and Finance by collecting and monitoring product usage stats at a transactional level - in order to raise automated and manual transbilling records – so customers can be invoiced in line with their contract
  • Provide commercial support and guidance for non-standard customer contracts ensuring data is correct
  • Product fulfilment of customer purchases – liaising with relevant teams (e.g. Application Support/) where required
  • Provide governance of AMS data to ensure customers are receiving the correct products and services and that access has been provisioned on time and/or terminated in-line with cancellation dates
  • Support the commercial leadership teams to ensure that Accounts and Opportunities are assigned correctly
  • Support the Salesforce and KPI teams by re-opening opportunities and correcting opportunity fields where required for financial reporting
  • Creation of reports and dashboards that support the commercial teams to manage their customers (e.g. upcoming renewals, overdue opportunities, win backs, cancellation reports)
  • Support the renewal process for all customers – including price notification letter analysis - looking at Price increases and contact allocation - for PNL’s to be delivered correctly in line with company t&c’s
  • Provide usage statistic reports for products where internal users are unable to view or run their own
  • Collect/run monthly usage stat reports out of local access management systems – storing in a central area for internal users to access
  • Implement changes to processes and procedures to increase efficiency and productivity
  • Assess and escalate high impact issues to the SOM
  • Support the business in the testing and roll out of new applications and enhancements
  • Creating and updating best practice documentation

Required Qualifications:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of compliance and attention to detail
  • Strong teamwork and influencing skills
  • Customer-centric approach
  • Educated to degree level or equivalent
  • Fluent in English

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Other European languages desirable

Why Join JD Power

JD Power powers auto-related decisions through proprietary data, advanced analytics, deep industry expertise, and workflows that connect insight to action. Operating across North America, Europe, and Australia, we help customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

As a virtual-first company, we offer flexible work arrangements, opportunities for learning and development, and a culture centered on the Values that guide how we work every day.

· We power our customers’ success. Everything we do is focused on helping customers make better decisions and achieve better outcomes.

· We are innovative, collaborative, and grounded in data. We combine advanced analytics with human expertise to deliver insight that holds up in the real world.

· We make things easy. We turn complexity into clarity so teams can act faster and with confidence.

· We get it done. We focus on execution, accountability, and results.

· We start with trust and prove it every day. Independence, integrity, and credibility are the foundation of our work.

<div class="content-intro"><p>Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: <strong>play video games.</strong> Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.</p></div><p>Discord's Safety ML team builds the machine learning systems that protect 200M+ users. The team's mission is to make Discord a place where people can build genuine friendships without exposure to harm, at a scale where manual review alone can never keep up.</p>
<p>We're looking for a highly technical, hands-on, and mission-driven Engineering Manager to lead our Safety ML team. As the manager responsible for Safety ML, you will own the detection systems that sit between attackers and our users; real-time and batch models for content understanding, account integrity, and platform abuse.</p>
<p><strong>What You'll Be Doing</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Build and lead an exceptional team of highly-engaged ML engineers by hiring, coaching, and instilling a sense of ownership and impact.</li>
<li>Drive the technical vision and roadmap for Safety ML by collaborating with your team and partners across Trust &amp; Safety, Product, Policy, Legal, and Data Science.</li>
<li>Own the end-to-end lifecycle of production safety models: defining new capabilities, measuring performance, and monitoring the operational health of systems that make millions of enforcement decisions per day.</li>
<li>Manage processes and leverage your technical expertise to continually raise the bar and ensure your team delivers extraordinary results.</li>
<li>Partner with Trust &amp; Safety on label quality, golden sets, and automating manual investigations.</li>
<li>Work with other Engineering Managers to continuously improve the Engineering organization and uphold our <a href="https://blog.discordapp.com/the-four-values-of-working-at-discord-90d5b5102cbc">workplace philosophy</a>.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>What you should have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>You have 5+ years of experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, Data Scientist, or Applied Scientist.</li>
<li>You have 3+ years of experience as an Engineering Manager and successfully managed a team of 5+ engineers.</li>
<li>You have hands-on depth in at least one of: abuse/fraud detection, content classification, behavioral modeling, graph-based modeling, or LLM-based classification systems.</li>
<li>You have strong communication skills and the ability to work well cross-functionally.</li>
<li>You thrive in ambiguous environments and get excited about figuring out solutions to complex problems, and then executing on them.</li>
<li>You are a first principles thinker that can work with others to come up with pragmatic solutions.</li>
<li>You have a proven record of shipping ML systems to production at scale.</li>
<li>You are passionate about coaching and leading other engineers, but can roll up your sleeves and get elbow deep in code when needed.</li>
<li>You keep up with the industry trends and continuously identify new technologies to leverage to solve technical problems</li>
</ul>
<p><em><br>The US base salary range for this full-time position is $272,000 to $340,000 + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.<br></em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Why Discord?&nbsp;</strong><br><br>Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. <strong>Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!</strong></p>
<p><strong>Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. </strong>We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know.</p>

<p>
